sections.title: 1. Overview — who, when, and what
sections.html:
Custom bass strings come from Heller-Bass (Gregor Heller, Klavierbaumeister — Eschelbronn, Germany). Order them as part of the order parts concurrent task, as early in the window as possible: strings are made to measure in Germany, so lead time matters — the set must be in hand before Restringing.

  • Email: service@hellerbass.de  ·  Phone: +49-6226-42444  ·  Web: hellerbass.de
  • Our Drive folder (forms, worked examples, past orders): Heller-Bass — bass string ordering ↗
  • When you send an order, mark the part Ordered on the piano's card (Store Map → concurrent tasks → order parts → “Bass strings — Heller-Bass”), and mark Received when the box arrives.

sections.title: 2. Complete bass sets
sections.html:
Method 1 — measure the piano (most accurate, recommended). Using the Heller-Bass tape measure, take two lengths for every bass string and enter them on the order form, one row per string:

  • A — from hitch pin to front bridge pin
  • B — from hitch pin to v-bar / agraffe
  • Plus, for each string: steel core Ø, copper Ø, and overall Ø (the form's three diameter columns). For uncommon instruments always include the overall diameters of the thickest and thinnest strings.

The form also asks for the instrument make, your address, and whether to include a tuning-pin order. A free tape measure is available on request from service@hellerbass.de.

  • Our copy of the form: HellerBass Order Form (PDF) ↗
  • Or submit online: hellerbass.de online order form ↗

Method 2 — send the old strings. Thread the old bass strings onto a wire in the correct order and mail them, with the instrument name and the count of singles / bi-chords / tri-chords. Cut the steel core several centimeters behind the deformation left by the v-bar so the speaking-length mark is preserved.

Method 3 — paper pattern (least accurate). Mail a paper pattern of the bass strings, and include the actual first and last old string of each section so Heller-Bass can verify the pattern.

sections.title: 3. Single / individual strings
sections.html:
For one-off replacements use the Individual Strings Order Form. Four measurements are essential, per the form's columns:

  • Eye to copper beginning
  • Copper length (or eye to copper end)
  • Steel core Ø
  • Overall Ø

Also note the quantity and the order specifications: was the string measured under tension or removed, the eye type (German, double German, French), wire shape (round or hexagonal), copper end form, and the note name if Heller-Bass should recalculate the string.

  • Our copy: Single Bass String Order Form (PDF) ↗

sections.title: 5. Sending the order & follow-through
sections.html:
Email orders: scan or photograph the completed form and send it to service@hellerbass.de from info@brighamlarsonpianos.com (so replies land with the office). Put a copy of what you sent in the Drive folder's Orders subfolder ↗.

Mailed orders (old strings or paper patterns) go to: Hellerbass, Ringstraße 4, 74927 Eschelbronn, Germany.

  • On the piano's Store Map card: mark the bass-string part Ordered when the order goes out and Received when it arrives — that's what keeps the restringing schedule honest.
